root_cause: Sales psychology, sales plays, brand voice and copy rules existed, but were not consistently runtime-mandatory before outbound execution and were not fully attributed back to observed business outcomes.
decision: Wire sales play selection, persuasion, human copy generation, exact message-quality proof, provider execution, outcome lineage and revenue learning into the existing canonical commercial loop instead of creating a parallel sales machine.
prevention: no outbound email or LinkedIn DM without exact quality-passed message hash
no internal taxonomy labels as prospect-facing personalization
trigger outreach requires human-readable source context and semantic source match
no generic openings, reply guilt, fake urgency or unsupported claims
sent/delivered/queued do not count as business outcomes
strategy promotion requires observed business outcomes and remains evidence-gated
reuse existing sales actions, outcomes, attribution, NBA, provider and learning authorities

delivery_closure.runtime_readback: closed_loop_v6 healthy=true; copy gate assurance healthy=true
